subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 2: 'sh-' at the start of words (ship, shop, shell)

show.line: Two letters, one sound! s and h say sh. Ship, shop, shell.

rounds.prompt: Say the sound with me. sh, as in ship!
Listen. sh, o, p. What word is it?
Does it start with sh or s? Sort the pictures.

hints: sh is quiet. Finger on your lips. sh!
s and h together make a new sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with sh.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Sock starts with s. Shoe starts with sh.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. sh, sh, shoe. Shoe starts with sh!

parent_line: Can read words that start with sh, like ship, shop and shell.
